lines.text: [tired, quiet] Night log. December third. Two fourteen A.M.
lines.asr: Night log December third two fourteen AM

lines.text: [low, uneasy] That fire door only opens out.
lines.sub: THAT FIRE DOOR ONLY OPENS OUT.
lines.asr: That fire door only opens out

lines.text: [whispering, terrified] It's right next to me.
